description:
## Build fix and cleanup

- **Release build fixed.** A cleanup edit left a few menu and player buttons with broken code that stopped the app from compiling; the release build now builds and installs cleanly again.
- **Removed unrelated files.** The stray NOTICE file and logo.png have been removed, and the README link updated.

## Cleanup

- **Discord removed.** The Discord sign-in and Rich Presence integration is gone from the app, along with its Settings entry.
- **Listen Together removed.** The whole listen-together feature (rooms, track suggestions, guest controls, top-bar toggle) is gone.
- **Migration leftovers, roadmap and issue templates removed.** The one-time SimpMusic migration, ROADMAP.md, MIGRATION.md and the GitHub issue templates are gone.

## Discord fixes

- **Discord sign-in is rebuilt to work correctly.** The app now uses only the officially supported parts of Discord: it signs you in with the "identify" permission and shows your linked account. It no longer tries to drive Discord’s servers directly, which Discord does not allow and which could make sign-in fail.

- **Clearer messages when something goes wrong.** If you decline the permission, if Discord rejects a request, or if the redirect isn’t set up in the Discord Developer Portal, you now get a specific, helpful message instead of a generic "Discord error".

- **If sign-in doesn’t return to the app,** add "lunaradiscord://oauth2/callback" under your app’s OAuth2 → Redirects in the Discord Developer Portal and save. The in-app setup note walks you through it.

## Music stops when you close the app

- **Closing the app from Recents now stops playback.** Swiping Lunara away from your recent apps fully stops the music, removes the media notification and shuts the player down — no more audio carrying on after the app is gone.

- **The media notification no longer keeps coming back.** The player service was being restarted by the system every time it was cleared, which re-posted the song notification over and over. It is now stopped for good once the app is closed, so the notification stays gone.

- **Background playback still works as normal.** Pressing Home or Back keeps the music playing with the notification controls; only swiping the app away from Recents stops it.

- **The old \"Stop music on task clear\" toggle has been removed** from Player settings, since stopping on close is now the default behaviour.

## The loading screen and onboarding follow your theme

- **Dark mode is dark from the first frame.** The splash and the first-run onboarding now read your theme, so opening the app in dark mode shows a dark loading screen and dark onboarding instead of a light one — and light mode shows light, exactly as chosen.

## Look & Feel

- **The preview is the real Lunara home.** It now mirrors the actual home screen — the quick-access cards, the mood chips, the "Similar to" album row and the "Mood and Genres" grid — instead of an old mock.

- **The Home tab is gone from Look & Feel.** Its layout settings (default tab, grid cell size, navigation bar style, slim navbar and the home search bar) now live together under Appearance.

## Loading states

- **Songs load with the Lunara mark.** The loading skeletons and any song without album art now show the Lunara logo instead of a generic music note.

## The icon is Lunara everywhere now

- **Every app icon is the green Lunara mark.** The launcher icon, the copy-link confirmation toast and the cast player badge all read from the one green mark, so the old orange logo is gone from every one of them.
- **If you still see the orange logo, the phone is showing a cached icon from the old install.** Fully uninstall the previous app first, then install this build (or restart the phone after installing). Android keeps the old launcher icon cached until the package's icon cache is cleared, so an install-on-top alone can keep showing the previous mark.

## Artist screen

- **The Subscribe button is now Favorite.** It bookmarks the artist locally with a heart, so there is no more dead YouTube subscribe in a build with no login.
- **Copying an artist link shows the Lunara mark** in the confirmation toast, matching the rest of the app.

## Lyrics

- **The Sources pill is hidden.** Lyrics now show the words and nothing else. You can still reach the provider picker from the lyrics menu when you want a different source.

## Playlists

- **The Sync playlist toggle is removed** everywhere, along with the Sync action in the playlist menu, since this build has no account to sync with.

## Look & Feel

- **The preview matches the app again.** It shows the All and Music filter pills at the top and always renders the search bar, so the mock reflects what opens on the home screen.

## A tidier library and home

- **The account chip is gone from Library.** The header is just the title and the search button now.
- **Cached and Uploaded are removed from the library**, and in their place sits a **Create playlist** card that opens the playlist editor straight away.
- **The library reads properly in light mode.** Liked, Your Top 50, Downloaded, Music on this device and every playlist name follow the theme instead of being painted white on a light card.

## Home

- **The dice-style shuffle tile is gone from the speed dial.** The grid is pinned items only.
- **The All and Music pills above Liked and For You are removed**, so the header opens straight on your music.

## Settings

- **The Look & Feel preview matches the real build.** It shows the current home — the quick-access cards, not the greeting card that was removed — and no account chip.

## Changelog

- **Release notes render with their formatting.** Headings, bullets and bold are read as intended instead of the raw `#` and `*` showing on screen.

## Light mode is readable now

- **The loading screen follows your theme.** It no longer flashes a light screen when the app is set to dark.
- **White-on-white text and icons are fixed.** Section titles, the navigation bar, chips, the library header, search and settings all read from the theme now, so nothing disappears against a light background any more.

## Speed dial

- **The shuffle button is gone.** The floating dice-style button that played a random song has been removed from the home screen.

## Settings

- **'Report a problem' has been removed completely**, along with the bug-report screen, the helper behind it and its translations.

## A redesigned interface

- **The whole interface has been reworked.** The home header, search, library, settings and the player have a fresh, cleaner look built on flat surfaces and the signature green accent.
- **Light mode actually works now.** Surfaces, cards and text read from the theme instead of hard-coded dark colours, so the light theme is light and the dark theme is dark - with readable contrast in both.

## A new logo

- **The app icon, splash screen, notification icon and in-app branding all use the new mark.** Every density, the adaptive icon, the store icon and the TV banner were regenerated from the one master artwork, so the mark is never cropped or half-cut again.

## Search

- **The search bar reads 'Search song, title, artist…'** instead of naming a single source.

## Two buttons where the overflow menu used to be

- **The player's three-dots menu is gone.** It held an entire screen of options - equaliser, audio output, volume, add to queue, play this a few times, don't play this, copy link, block artist, add to library, pin to speed dial, listen together, details, output, advanced - none of which is something anybody reaches for while a song is playing.
- **In its place: `+` and download.** The `+` puts the current song into a playlist; the download button keeps it offline, shows a spinner while it downloads, and turns into the offline mark once it is saved, where tapping it removes the download again.
- **The queue header** carries the same `+` instead of the menu.

## Home

- **The recent-music rail is called 'Jump back in'**, the name the old Yours tab used for the same list.

## Fixed

- **The build compiles again.** 3.4.0 removed the Music Recognizer widget and its resources, but the Android 12 widget definition in `res/xml-v31` still pointed at them, so resource linking failed. Nothing about the app changed beyond that.

## The mic is gone

- **Song recognition has been removed**, along with everything that came with it: the microphone permission, the Quick Settings tile, the home-screen widget, the recognition screens and their history, and the mic buttons in the search bar and on the Search page.

## Yours is gone

- **The Yours tab has been removed.** The bottom bar is now Home, Search and Library.

## Tidier

- **The About row in Settings** reads *Lunara* instead of *Version and developer*.
- **The changelog is Lunara's own**, not the version numbering the project was forked from.

## A quieter home

- **The greeting card is gone.** Good morning, good afternoon, good evening and the hero image behind them no longer take the top of the page. Home opens on the logo, the search bar and your music.

## About

- **About Lunara is about Lunara.** The page no longer carries a version badge or a developer card.
- **The About row in Settings** now reads *Lunara* instead of *Version and developer*.

## Updater

- **No more `universal - FOSS` label.** The current-version row shows the version and nothing else.
- **Beta updates are gone.** There is one update channel, and it is the finished release.

## Fixed

- **The build compiles again.** 3.2.0 removed a helper and clipped the comment above a neighbouring function, which failed the build. Nothing about the app changed beyond that.

## Lunara unscrambles its own streams

- **The bundled extractor is gone.** Reading the site's player script, pulling the signature and challenge functions out of it and running them are all done by code in this project. No third-party streaming library is shipped any more.

## About

- **The page is about the app, not its author** — the personal card, the links to private accounts, the *Buy me a coffee* button and the *Made with love by ...* footer are all removed.

## Updates

- **The updater points at this project's releases.** It used to ask a third-party domain first and fall back to a mirror that has never carried a Lunara build, so a check could only ever fail.

## The Lunara logo, everywhere

- **Every icon is the real mark.** The launcher icon, the adaptive and legacy variants, the splash, the notification icon, the TV banner and the store listing are all generated from the master artwork.
- **The accent colour is Lunara's own** — the violet of the note head and the teal of the sphere, taken from the artwork itself.

## Simpler

- **The account section is gone.** No sign-in button, no profile chip, no account sheet.
- **Listen Together is gone.** No tab, no top-bar button, no invite links, no onboarding page.
- **Settings is a short list**: the appearance toggles, Appearance, Storage, About, Changelog and Updater.

## Underneath

- **Release builds are signed with the real key.** The build was falling back to the debug keystore, which is what makes Android report an unknown developer and refuse to install over an existing copy.

## Lunara 3.0.0

The first Lunara release. A music player for Android that streams from YouTube Music and plays what is already on your device, with lyrics, downloads, offline playback and a look that follows you from phone to tablet to Android Auto.

Free and open source under GPL-3.0. No account, no ads, no tracking.
